weekly-routine.description: New articles, more verified data and one site improvement, reviewed by the manager in a pull request.

steps.part: Write up to two articles, following the playbook.
Add verified entries to the project's data, following the playbook.
Make one improvement to the site, following the playbook.

review.part: The final review: open the sources of the central claims, check every change, fix what is wrong and write the pull request text with your verdict.
